svg.title: DDIM quadratic timestep selection, Appendix D.2

cc:Work.dc:title: DDIM quadratic timestep selection, Appendix D.2
cc:Work.dc:description: Illustration: T=1000, S=10, c=10. Quadratic steps: 10, 40, 90, 160, 250, 360, 490, 640, 810, 1000. Sampling traverses these points in reverse order.
